name: Remove Enchantment Incompatibility
summary: Removes all enchantment incompatibility rules so any enchantments can be combined on one item, at both the enchanting table and anvil. It applies to modded enchantments as well.

mechanics.title: Limits that remain
mechanics.description: You still cannot put two copies of the same enchantment on one item, and each enchantment must still be valid for the item type.

vanilla_changes.change: Exclusive sets are lifted: Protection types together, Sharpness/Smite/Bane of Arthropods, Infinity with Mending, Silk Touch with Fortune, Depth Strider with Frost Walker, Multishot with Piercing, Riptide with Loyalty/Channeling.

getting_started: Nothing to configure; combine enchantments in the anvil as normal.
editor_notes: Server-installed; no config. Interactions with other enchantment mods or datapacks not checked.
